notes: MotherDuck is a serverless DuckDB warehouse reached with a DuckDB client over its own wire protocol, not a public REST API, so this OpenAPI document is synthesized from the adaptor surface (ast.json). Verified against ast.json: all 3 public operations are covered — query, insert, execute — modelled as POST endpoints returning QueryResult/MutationResult. Common/utility exports are excluded as they are not external calls. The server URL is a mock placeholder.
